subject: Quick follow-up: pick 2x 30m walkthroughs & pre-demo infra checklist
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Barnes <elliot@straitline.com>, Aditi Shah <aditi@straitline.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up: pick 2x 30m walkthroughs & pre-demo infra checklist

Hi Elliot / Aditi —

Thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the 30m walkthrough: 

- Call recap (2 minutes): looked at your ingestion/ETL patterns, main pain is inference latency on batch scoring and operational cost predictability. You flagged SSO and data-retention as must-haves for pilots.
- Goal for next session: a concise 30-minute product walkthrough focused on your ingestion -> serving flow and expected latency/cost tradeoffs.

Pick one of these 30-minute windows (all PT):
  • Option A: Tue 24 Jun, 10:00–10:30 PT
  • Option B: Wed 25 Jun, 14:00–14:30 PT
  • Backup: Thu 26 Jun, 09:00–09:30 PT

Pre-demo asks (helps us tailor the session):
- Who should join from your infra/security team (name + email)?
- Any sample payload size (avg tokens / batch size) we should plan for?
- Will we be allowed to record the session?

I attached a one-page agenda (redwood-30min-agenda.pdf) and a short pre-demo checklist. Once you pick a slot I’ll send a calendar invite and loop in Priyom (SE) to cover the tech bits.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Thanks Elliot — Option A locked.

A few quick replies to your questions: 
- Recording: yes, we can record the walkthrough and share a short clip and notes afterward.
- SOC2 / compliance: we have a SOC2 pack — I’ll share the secure link after this thread (we don’t attach full reports to email). In the meantime, here’s the access link: https://drive.google.com/redwood/soc2-pack (we’ll pass along a formal NDA if needed).

Priyom — I’m adding you to lead the tech portion (10–22 min deep-dive). Can you confirm you can run a short demonstration of our serving pipeline and call out expected latency/cost for a 1k-tokens batch?

Aditi / Elliot — two small asks before the session:
1) Send the name + email of the security contact who should be in the invite (if that’s Aditi, let us know if there’s a different alias to use).
2) If you have a representative sample payload shape (json schema or sample record), drop it here or in the shared Drive link so Priyom can prepare.

I’ll send the calendar invite for Tue 24 Jun, 10:00–10:30 PT once Priyom confirms.

Best,
—
Marissa

Quick internal sync — I’m good to run the 24 Jun session and will cover: 
- 0–3 min: quick intro and success criteria (I’ll confirm the 1–2 KPIs to surface)
- 3–12 min: architecture walkthrough (ingest, model selection, batching, KV cache)
- 12–22 min: short live demo (sample request flows & perf numbers)
